# Pokémon Survivors

> A free, unofficial Vampire Survivors-style Pokémon fan game (action roguelite / bullet heaven) that runs in the browser and on phones, with no download, no sign-up, no ads and no purchases. Available in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Made by Pedro Barretto; open source on GitHub.

Pick one of 27 starter Pokémon from every region (Kanto to Paldea), walk around and let it attack on its own. Survive 15 minutes of wild Pokémon hordes, collect experience, learn moves, equip held items and evolve mid-run, then face Mewtwo. After the victory you can keep going in an endless mode, where the horde keeps scaling and Arceus hunts you as the reaper.

- 27 starters, each with its full 3-stage evolution line, stats, signature move and learnset
- 23 moves and 19 held items; a maxed move plus the right item evolves (Ember + Charcoal → Flamethrower)
- Type matchups, burn, poison and paralysis, and a manual special attack per type (Blast Burn, Hydro Cannon, Frenzy Plant)
- Legendary bosses with telegraphed attacks: Onix, Snorlax, Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, Mew and Mewtwo
- Legendary rifts: optional portals to walled arenas with Lugia, Ho-Oh, Kyogre, Groudon, Rayquaza and Dialga (possibly shiny), for big rewards
- Endless mode after Mewtwo, scored by time survived, with Arceus as a hunting reaper that can be defeated
- Shiny wild Pokémon and shiny starters; Poké Dollars and permanent upgrades in the Poké Mart
- Pokémon Mystery Dungeon-style pixel art (PMD SpriteCollab)
- Original chiptune soundtrack composed in code; Settings for music and effects volume, damage numbers, screen shake and language
- Touch controls with a floating joystick; installable as a fullscreen app

Good fit for people looking for: a Pokémon version of Vampire Survivors, a Pokémon roguelike or roguelite playable online, a free Pokémon browser game, or a Pokémon fan game for mobile without downloading.

## Play

- [Play in English](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/en/)
- [Jogar em português](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/)

## Guides and reference

- [Pokédex](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/en/pokedex/): every Pokémon in the game (27 starters with their evolutions, wild enemies, bosses and legendaries) with animated and shiny sprites, types, in-game stats, moves, specials and when each one shows up. Portuguese: [Pokédex](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/pokedex/)
- [How to play](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/en/guide/): controls (keyboard, gamepad, touch), how a run works, levels and moves, move evolutions with held items, the special attack, types and status, boss timeline, shinies, map items and the Poké Mart, with the game's numbers. Portuguese: [Guia](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/guia/)
- [Changelog](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/en/changelog/): every update, newest first. Portuguese: [Novidades](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/novidades/)
- [Legal, privacy and credits](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/en/legal/): unofficial fan game, no ads or purchases, licenses, no personal data collected (localStorage only). Portuguese: [Legal](https://www.pokemonsurvivors.com/legal/)
